card.name: Linking words before opioid drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas right before a specific opioid name (morphine, methadone, hydrocodone, oxymorphone) in opioid labels. Seen after 'converted', 'such as heroin,', 'effect of', and after a dose number.

modes.label: Conversion wording
modes.description: 'to' or 'from' in switching between opioid products, just before the next opioid name.
modes.example: ate Extended-Release Tablets Patients receiving other oral hydrocodone-containing formulations may be converted<< to>> hydrocodone bitartrate extended

modes.label: Lists of opioids
modes.description: A comma or 'including' inside a list of opioid examples, before the next drug name.
